headline: Doodie Lo Keeps $10k Promise for Chicago Fallen Families
body: Trap Lore Ross reports Doodie Lo has fulfilled a pledge to distribute $10,000 to mothers of Chicago's fallen. The post states the funds are going to families affected by the city's ongoing conflicts. Ross mentions additional announcements for the youth are coming. The post has garnered 6,092 likes and 380 comments.
